name: Drug Abuse
overview: Scripture warns against the deceptive and destructive nature of excessive drinking and substance abuse, portraying strong drink as a mocker that leads to unwise behavior and ruin (Proverbs 20:1; Isaiah 5:11). Such indulgence is listed among the works of the flesh that separate individuals from inheriting the kingdom of God (Galatians 5:19, 21). Instead of being controlled by substances, believers are called to be filled with the Spirit, living in holiness and resisting temptation (Ephesians 5:18; Matthew 6:13).
